source: Thaumcraft 4.2.3.5 original private oracle; bounded early-M05 bindings plus explicit native-content prerequisites
source_hash_policy: Java sources decoded as UTF-8 without BOM; CRLF and lone CR normalized to LF; all other characters and final newline preserved. Binary and joined.srg hashes use unmodified bytes.

joined_srg.use: Identifiers only: original SRG Items/Blocks fields to obfuscated vanilla fields

vanilla_client.use: Identifiers only: cached ade/ajn static registry-name strings inspected with javap; original vanilla metadata flattened explicitly

source_anchors.native_resource_identifiers: item_resource#registerIcons:80-100; identifiers only, not aspect amounts

source_anchors.tools_and_armor_bonus_not_in_this_unit: crafting_manager#getBonusTags:383-410; runtime max-merge bonuses, not ConfigAspects complex registrations
source_anchors.salis_derived_direct: ConfigAspects421: unculled balanced-shard base + praecantatio2 minus vitreus; native ObjectAspectResolver evaluates this anchored expression, not a literal row or the final six-aspect display
source_anchors.piston_complex: ConfigAspects332: Blocks.field_150331_J wildcard piston adds machina2 then motus4 to the generated recipe base through ThaumcraftApi259-267; existing-direct quirk269-273 is unchanged. CraftingManager762-788 scales ingredients before this addition; ApiHelper40-80 later culls bonus tags to six.
source_anchors.hungry_chest_trapdoor: ConfigAspects336: original wildcard wooden trapdoor contributes raw complex motus1, flattened only to minecraft:oak_trapdoor. Hungry Chest has no original direct registration; its scan tags remain recipe-derived.

policy.coverage: A selected early vanilla resource family, six primal shards, literal native material variants including quicksilver drops, eight original native ores, magical wood/leaves/saplings/plants, arcane stone/bricks and two phial bases; extended by original piston complex row332 and wooden trapdoor row336 for native content prerequisites, and by the original vanilla object tags of ConfigAspects176-346 (the plain blocks and items, the stone brick and sandstone metadata families, the five skull variants, the chainmail set, the horse armours, the food, seed and music disc items, and the complex additions of the rails, buttons, pressure plates, lever, doors, arrow, ender eye, jukebox, note block, bookshelf, brewing stand, fishing rod, flower pot, carrot on a stick and mushroom stew), the milk bucket row317, the three loot bags rows407-409 and the alchemy furnace row427. Not a complete ConfigAspects port or gameplay-completion claim.
policy.direct: Authoritative original values override divergent legacy 1.12 fallback values with put/putAll; do not treat the override as a conflict. Preserve explicitly empty direct lists.
policy.complex: Only raw supplied additions for the no-existing-original-tag branch. The caller supplies the 0.75-scaled recipe base. Never add these to an existing original direct tag: API269-273 max-merges the old amount with itself, not the supplied amount.
policy.identifiers: All modern_ids are explicit existing item identifiers. No wildcard/path-pattern expansion and no inferred future Thaumcraft registrations. The caller validates against completed target registries.
policy.iron_nugget_adaptation: minecraft:iron_nugget replaces the original modded nuggetIron / ConfigItems.itemNugget metadata 0. This is an explicit identifier adaptation using original line136 metallum1, not an assertion that vanilla 1.7.10 had iron nuggets.
policy.copper_nugget_adaptation: thaumcraft:copper_nugget replaces the original modded nuggetCopper / ConfigItems.itemNugget metadata 1 and thaumcraft:cluster_copper the original native copper cluster of metadata 17. The original registered both only when Config.foundCopperIngot, and copper is vanilla in 1.21.1.
policy.torch_and_workbench: Original line244 torch is direct lux1, not complex recipe energy; line340 crafting_table is direct fabrico4. The retained legacy torch registration is not the specification.
policy.phials: phial_empty is direct vacuos1; phial_filled has an explicitly empty direct base. PhialData's 8 contained aspects are the caller's stack bonus, never a static binding here.
policy.piston_mechanical_prerequisite: Only minecraft:piston receives the ORIGINAL raw complex machina2/motus4 addition, never a replacement direct list or a precomputed final yield. Recipe derivation, cap/bonus/cull and legacy-fallback suppression reuse the existing complex path. Wooden trapdoor336 is separately included for Hungry Chest; sticky piston333 and other unselected mechanical rows remain outside these bounded additions.
policy.restored_original_vanilla_rows: Rows restored from the oracle keep the original literal amounts of their ConfigAspects line; only the 1.21.1 identifier is an explicit adaptation (hardened clay is terracotta, monster egg is infested_stone, the four stone brick and three sandstone metadata variants are their own blocks, the five skull variants are the five head items, reeds is sugar_cane, fish is cod, web is cobweb, mob_spawner is spawner, the wooden button, pressure plate, fence gate and door are their oak forms, golden_rail is powered_rail, the record_X discs are the music_disc_X items). Every vanilla identifier of this resource is checked against the 1.21.1 item registry by EarlyObjectAspectBindingsTest.

unsupported_branches: No invented direct tags for raw_iron, raw_gold, raw_copper, raw metal blocks, copper, netherite, deepslate ores, nether gold ore, or post-1.7 wood families.

Conditional mod-metal branches ConfigAspects148-175 are enabled for copper only, because copper is vanilla in 1.21.1; the tin, silver and lead branches stay unmapped, because 1.21.1 has no tin, no silver and no lead at all.
Blaze powder, magma cream and other recipe outputs without an original literal direct registration remain recipe-derived; no guessed base or additions are supplied.

Original lit_redstone_ore line130 and lit_furnace line337 are distinct legacy blocks, not extra overrides for the modern unlit item. The modern item uses original oreRedstone line129 and furnace line338 respectively.
No general tool/boot/enchantment bonuses: those depend on runtime item/material state and max-merge semantics outside this data unit.
No balance_shard, salis_mundus expression, crystal blocks, dynamic resource expressions, arbitrary ore-dictionary members, or unregistered native nugget/cluster/block variants.

The original API existing-tag complex branch is not modeled as additive; all selected complex rows have no earlier original direct binding. The resource does not claim the remaining registrations are ported.

The remaining original vanilla rows stay outside this resource: the melon item row214 (1.21.1 shares one minecraft:melon identifier with the melon block of the retained legacy row, so the two original tags cannot both exist), the potion item rows243 and 363 (the native potion tag is computed from the potion contents), the end portal block row297 (1.21.1 has no end portal item), the golden apple rows304 and 305 (the enchanted golden apple has no recipe base), the plain sandstone row203 and the enchanted book row293 (empty complex additions only), and the cultist armour rows437-446, which the port does not contain.
